entries.text: Bug Fixes bedrock: send the user profile ID in the request body Amazon Bedrock reads user_profile_id from the request body and ignores the anthropic-user-profile-id header, so a profile ID given to AnthropicBedrock was not applied. AnthropicBedrock now moves it into the body of Messages requests and no longer sends the header. A user_profile_id already in the body takes priority over the header. Some models on Bedrock do not support user profiles. A request to one of them with a profile ID now fails with a 400 error; before, the ID was ignored. Leave the ID off requests to those models.

It no longer throws SessionMemoryError for such a session. The API reports an archived session as terminated. tools: stop the session tool runner from running the tool calls of a terminated session thread The runner also stops waiting for a confirmation of these calls and no longer yields them, including a denied call (confirmation: 'deny') and a call to a tool that it does not own. A call that the runner starts before it reads the session thread's session.thread_status_terminated event still runs to the end, and the runner yields it with posted: false when the API refuses the result. entries.text: Features api: add source and error codes to the RBAC Role read endpoints api: add Update Bundle, which sets a Claude Tag Bundle's instructions, and return instructions on Bundle Bug Fixes helpers: keep $schema out of the transformed schema description streaming: reject characters that aren't JSON in streamed tool input The lenient parser for streamed tool input used to skip characters and words that aren't JSON, such as a comment, and to join numbers such as 12 3, so it could return a value that the text doesn't contain. It now rejects such text, and a stream with such tool input fails with an error, as it already did for a bad escape or a missing comma. Valid and truncated JSON parse as before. tools: bound the grep tool's search at 60s where ripgrep is missing, and keep its regex off the main thread tools: compare directory names exactly when confining file paths on Windows tools: fully resolve file tool paths that pass through a dangling symlink tools: ignore ripgrep config files in the agent toolset grep tool tools: leave symlinks that point outside /memories out of listings tools: normalize file modes of extracted skill files Extracted files now get 0644, or 0755 if any execute bit is set, in 0700 directories, whatever the archive recorded. The system tar must accept --no-same-owner and --no-same-permissions. tools: pass over a tar or unzip inside the directories the agent toolset's file tools can write setupSkills takes tar, unzip and a helper that tar starts, such as g
